blocks.source: 【RPGレビュー】ドラゴンクエスト７
シナリオは短いイベントの集合という形式を取っている。石版を集めることで過去の世界にワープし、各地で問題を解決する。それぞれのイベントは今までのＤＱと比較しても、やや暗め。重たいながらも印象に残るイベントもいくつかあった。
blocks.translation: The scenario takes the form of a collection of short events. By collecting stone tablets, you warp to the worlds of the past and solve problems in each area. Compared with previous Dragon Quest games, each event is somewhat darker. There were also several weighty yet memorable events.

blocks.source: プレイ時間は長く、普通にクリアするだけで８０時間以上も。クリア後の隠し要素まで含めると１００時間は超える。
blocks.translation: The playtime is long, taking more than 80 hours just to complete the main game normally. Including the hidden content after completion, it exceeds 100 hours.

blocks.source: ただ、その長さゆえに批判される部分も。単に石版を集めるためにダンジョンに行かされることが多く、特に過去と現在の２つの世界で同じダンジョンを使い回すところもいくつかある。
blocks.translation: However, its length also gives rise to some criticism. You are often sent into dungeons simply to collect stone tablets, and several dungeons in particular are reused in both the past and present worlds.

blocks.source: シナリオの構成上、世界や物語につながりが感じられないのも盛り上がりに欠けやすい原因。プレイ時間の長さもあって、シリーズでは最も途中で飽きてしまった人が多いのでは？
blocks.translation: Because of the scenario's structure, the lack of a sense of connection between the worlds and the story also makes it difficult to build excitement. Given the lengthy playtime, this may be the game in the series that caused the most players to lose interest partway through.

blocks.source: この作品から『話す』によって、仲間と会話をすることが可能となった。テキスト量は膨大で、町人のちょっとした会話にも反応してくれたりする。重たい話が多いので、マリベルやガボの様な性格が明るい仲間との会話は救われる。
blocks.translation: Starting with this game, the “Talk” command made it possible to converse with your companions. The amount of text is enormous, and they even react to casual remarks from townspeople. Since many of the stories are heavy, conversations with cheerful companions like Maribel and Gabo are a welcome relief.

blocks.source: 安心のドラクエバランス。ただし、戦闘・成長システムに関してはＤＱ６と同じ『転職』を継続して使用しており、大きな変化はない。
blocks.translation: It has the reassuring balance typical of Dragon Quest. However, the battle and growth systems continue to use the same “Vocations” system as DQVI, so there are no major changes.

blocks.source: ＤＱ３では自由なパーティ編成＆転職、ＤＱ４ではＡＩ＆馬車、ＤＱ５では仲間モンスター、ＤＱ６では転職（ＤＱ３とは別物）、というように毎度何かしら新しいことをやっていたのけれど、今回は特徴が薄め。
blocks.translation: DQIII had freely configurable parties and vocations, DQIV had AI and the wagon, DQV had monster companions, and DQVI had vocations (different from those in DQIII)—each game introduced something new. This time, however, its defining features are less pronounced.

blocks.source: その転職だが、肝となる職業毎のバランスは悪化した箇所も。『剣の舞』や『怒涛の羊』などの序盤～中盤で覚えることが可能な特技が非常に強力で、ＭＰを消費せずに通常攻撃の何倍ものダメージを与えられる。最後までこれらの特技を連発するワンパターンな戦法でゴリ押しできてしまう。ただでさえ長いので戦法が単調になると、余計に飽きやすい懸念も。
blocks.translation: As for the vocation system, the balance between the individual vocations, which is its core, has also worsened in some respects. Techs such as “Sword Dance” and “Furious Flock of Sheep,” which can be learned from the early to middle stages, are extremely powerful, allowing you to deal several times the damage of a normal attack without consuming MP. You can force your way through the game using the same one-pattern strategy of repeatedly using these Techs all the way to the end. Since the game is already so long, there is also concern that monotonous battles will make it even easier to lose interest.

blocks.source: 新要素としてモンスター職も追加されたが、必要性はあまり感じられない。覚える呪文・特技が一般の職業と大きく重なっており、有用なのは『マダンテ』など、ごく一部の技に限られる。転職には魔物が低確率で落とす『心』が必要になるという仕様も厳しい。『ダンビラムーチョ心』が手に入らずに延々と粘った人も少なくないはず。
blocks.translation: Monster vocations were also added as a new feature, but they do not feel particularly necessary. The spells and Techs they learn overlap heavily with those of regular vocations, and only a very small number of abilities, such as “Magic Burst,” are useful. It is also harsh that changing vocations requires a “heart” dropped by monsters at a low rate. Surely quite a few people spent an endless amount of time trying to obtain a “Dumbiramucho Heart.”

blocks.source: 当時のＰＳのゲームは操作性やロード時間に、問題がある作品ばかりだったが、このＤＱ７は例外。戦闘テンポ、マップの切替時間等、ＳＦＣ時代とほとんど変わらない快適性を持っている。ただし、フリーズすることもあって困るけれど……。
blocks.translation: Most PlayStation games at the time had problems with controls or loading times, but DQVII was an exception. Its battle tempo, map transition times, and other aspects provide a level of comfort almost unchanged from the Super Famicom era. However, it can freeze sometimes, which is troublesome...

blocks.source: キャラクターは２Ｄ。マップは３Ｄという構成。町の中ではＬＲボタンによって視点変更が可能。ＦＦ７の様な方向に無理して真似をしなかったのは評価できる。
blocks.translation: The characters are 2D, while the maps are 3D. In towns, you can change the viewpoint using the L and R buttons. It deserves credit for not forcing itself to imitate the direction taken by FFVII.

blocks.source: ただし、某イベントで流れるムービーは無謀だったのか、各地で出来をツッコまれる始末。でも、ＤＱ９では挽回したので、将来リメイクすることがあれば、悪くないものになると期待したい。
blocks.translation: However, perhaps the movie shown during a certain event was overly ambitious, as its quality became the subject of criticism in various places. Still, Dragon Quest IX made up for it, so if the game is ever remade in the future, I hope it will turn out well.

blocks.source: コミカル要素を含んだ通常戦闘やボス戦闘が特徴的。かと思えば、暗めの曲が充実しているというのも、この作品らしい。強い印象を残すような曲は少ないが、フィッシュベルの曲など聞いていて安心感のある曲が多い。でも、ダーマ神殿の曲だけはループが短すぎて手抜きっぽい気がする。
blocks.translation: The regular and boss battles featuring comedic elements are distinctive. On the other hand, the abundance of darker tracks is also characteristic of this game. There are few songs that leave a particularly strong impression, but many, such as the track from Fishbel, provide a comforting feeling when heard. However, the track from the Dharma Temple alone has such a short loop that it feels somewhat half-hearted.
